evidence: Implements BIP 54 consensus validation rules in src/consensus/tx_verify.cpp, src/consensus/consensus.h, and src/validation.cpp.
rationale: The PR implements BIP 54 consensus rules to fix known consensus weaknesses including CVE-2017-12842 Merkle tree collisions, quadratic sigops exhaustion, and timewarp retarget manipulation. While activation is restricted to regtest, providing upstream consensus verification logic and regression harnesses is strategically important to preparing the consensus cleanup soft fork.
